description: Planned and under-construction Texas grid projects near a site, in a county, or for a utility: new substations, approved new or rebuilt transmission lines, and substation upgrades, from ERCOT RPG and TPIT filings, PUCT CCN dockets and utility announcements (Barrio Energy research). Each project has status (proposed, approved, under construction, energized), expected in-service date, voltage, length, owner and utility, estimated cost, docket, why it is being built, a summary and source links, plus how precisely it is placed. Totals by type and cost come first. Use when someone asks what grid upgrades are coming near a site, where new 345 or 765 kV substations are planned, what a utility is building, or when new capacity arrives. Pro; free accounts see the totals and the nearest few names. Free accounts get every location and type; names, sizes, owners and dates are Pro.

address.description: Texas street address, e.g. '1201 Main St, Houston, TX'. Use this or lat/lng.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lng instead of address.

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of address.

radius_mi.description: Radius around the location in miles. Default 25, max 150.
